Subject: AWS offer: ecosystem hooks + field playbook (draft for review)

Team — attaching the latest draft of the AWS Offer product page copy plus a short co-sell playbook. High-level asks: 

1) Copy clarity: are the ecosystem/value hooks (partner integrations, data residency, Dedicated offering) succinct and buyer-oriented?
2) Field enablement: can the one-pager playbook be used by an AM/SE in a 10–15 minute briefing?
3) Operational: any SKU/AMI wording that will block Ops or Marketplace validation?

Attachments: aws_offer_product_page_copy_v2.docx, co-sell-playbook-draft.pdf, ami-usage-screenshot.png

I added a small section called "Ecosystem Hooks" where we call out: "Works with S3, Glue, and common ETL tools; integrates with customer VPCs and IRSA patterns." Kimberly, can you sanity-check the compliance blurb? Marissa, please flag anything that doesn't serve as an easy field script. Mateo, want your take on the buybox/usage example snippets.

Goal: get internal sign-off by EOD Friday so I can send to AWS partner ops next week.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Partner GTM Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: AWS offer: ecosystem hooks + field playbook (draft for review)

Got it — quick pass below. Inline notes saved in the doc (see comments) but high-level: 

- Compliance blurb: tighten the wording around "customer data never leaves VPC" — that's a hard claim. Suggest: "Data processed within customer-managed VPCs when deployed via Redwood Private; refer to our Private deployment docs for network architecture."
- SKU language: avoid stating "per-hour burst" — marketplace prefers committed terms + on-demand footnotes. 
- Callouts: the "Works with S3, Glue" line is good; add a short example sentence for Glue use case (ingest -> batch embed -> index).

Also: the field playbook is too dense for a 10-minute brief. Recommend a 1-slide TL;DR version (key customer personas, 3-step value demo, ask/CTA). I've attached a quick slide I used last month — will paste into drive.

"On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 09:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the latest draft ..."

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace & Partner Ops

From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@amazon.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-partner-ops@amazon.com
Date: 2026-10-22T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS offer: ecosystem hooks + field playbook (draft for review)

Thanks for sharing, Dylan. A couple notes from the AWS Marketplace side: 

1) Listing claims: we cannot use wording that implies guaranteed pricing or SLA unless backed by a committed plan; keep to capability & feature statements (e.g., "supports on-prem VPC deployment" vs "keeps customer data on-prem").
2) AM/SE pitch: call out the "Try in your account" trial path clearly — buyers gravitate to trial workflows. If you have an AM/SE quick demo gif or an AMI screenshot, add it to the hero. The screenshot you sent helps.
3) Co-sell: include an explicit "How to co-sell" checklist: 1) register opportunity in APN, 2) attach the Marketplace listing, 3) request co-sell support. We'll share the APN link after you publish.

FYI I've looped in partner-ops for any SKU/footnote constraints. Also cc'ing Jared Li from Acme; Jared — happy to answer product/usage questions.

Best,
Nora
Nora Chen
Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
